assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single seamless material texture for a 32x32 pixel-art roguelike wall, not a scene. Generate a perfectly square, flat front-on patch filling the entire image edge to edge. Weathered warm gray-brown plaster of an abandoned Japanese festival alley: old cement, restrained pale beige plaster chips, small worn patches revealing dark brown undercoat, low soot and rain stains. Crisp hand-placed chunky pixel clusters on a strict logical 32x32 grid, displayed enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. Muted medium-dark taupe with restrained warm sand highlights and dark brown flecks, roughly 12 colors. No large cracks, no brick pattern, no framing, no perspective, no shadows cast by objects, no scenery, no text, no gradient, no blur, no micro-detail. This is a reusable flat material to be clipped onto an existing connected 22-pixel-high wall silhouette; do not draw the wall shape or top edge.

No people, no lanterns, no extra props outside stall, no background floor, no scenery, no text or letters, no lettering, no glow, no smooth lighting, no antialiasing. Entire sprite fully visible, small transparent margin, genuinely transparent RGBA background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated small hanging Japanese festival paper lantern sprite for a 32px-grid top-down roguelike.
